processing.description: Read loss-country-annual: WRI's table gadm__tcl__iso_change v20260424 queried through the Global Forest Watch Data API with the SQL in the file's URL (https://data-api.globalforestwatch.org/dataset/gadm__tcl__iso_change/v20260424/download/csv?sql=SELECT%20iso%2C%20umd_tree_cover_loss__year%2C%20SUM%28umd_tree_cover_loss__ha%29%20AS%20umd_tree_cover_loss__ha%2C%20SUM%28umd_tree_cover_loss_from_fires__ha%29%20AS%20umd_tree_cover_loss_from_fires__ha%20FROM%20data%20WHERE%20umd_tree_cover_density_2000__threshold%20%3D%2030%20GROUP%20BY%20iso%2C%20umd_tree_cover_loss__year%20ORDER%20BY%20iso%2C%20umd_tree_cover_loss__year), at a tree canopy cover in 2000 of at least 30 percent. Hectares as in the file, not rounded.
A country and year with no row in the file has no loss recorded for it; nothing is filled in.

World: read loss-global-annual (the same query without the country grouping), 2001–2025. Checked that the countries, with the codes left out below, add up to it exactly in every year, for all loss and for loss due to fire.
Not published as countries: GADM codes with no entity in our table (XAD 80 ha; Z01 4,365 ha; Z06 555 ha; Z07 164,532 ha, all years together). Their loss is included in the world totals.

scope.basis: Tree cover loss: stand-replacing disturbance, or the complete removal of tree cover canopy, of vegetation taller than 5 m, mapped each year from Landsat at 30 m (Hansen/UMD, Global Forest Change v1.13), where tree canopy cover was at least 30 percent in 2000. Loss is not deforestation: it includes plantation harvest, fire and natural disturbance, and regrowth is not subtracted. Method changes from 2011 and 2015 make early and late years less comparable. Loss due to fire: UMD/GLAD (Tyukavina et al. 2022), a part of all loss.
scope.geography: Countries and territories (GADM's country codes, mapped to ISO 3166-1) and the world, which also includes areas GADM codes separately (XAD, Z01, Z06, Z07).

title: Tree cover lost each year, and the part due to fire
